name: Samantha L.
text: This is officially my new fav studio on Peerspace. Cole was super friendly and helpful and there were so many sets to choose from. I'll definitely have to book again so that I could make great use of everything there. I'd recommend to anyone. 10/10 experience!

name: Gilbert Q.
text: Can't wait to book again! A MUST BOOK SPACE, if you're reading this invest in yourself & make it happen :)

name: Eric R.
text: Great working with Cole, really friendly and very helpful host. This was my second time booking with him.

name: Gabriel D.
text: I had an amazing experience at the studio! The versatility of the space is incredible, with so many different setups and creative environments to work with. The creative potential truly feels boundless — you can walk in with one idea and quickly find yourself inspired to explore several more. What really made the experience stand out was the host, Cole. He was extremely accommodating and helpful every step of the way. Between the endless creative possibilities of the studio and Cole's hospitality and support, it's a space I'd absolutely recommend to anyone looking to bring unique concepts and ideas to life. I'm already looking forward to coming back!

name: CoCo F.
text: Absolutely incredible creative space! We booked this studio to create promotional content for six different songs, and it exceeded every expectation. Having so many unique sets in one location made it easy to capture a wide variety of looks without ever leaving the building. Cole was an outstanding host — welcoming, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure we had a great experience. If you're looking for a creative space with multiple high-quality sets for music videos, photo shoots, social media content, or branding sessions, I highly recommend this studio.

name: Beck Z.
text: best studio of all time

name: Haillie W.
text: This studio was one of the coolest I've been to. Every room has a different feel and makes it seem as if you're in an entirely different building every room you step into. Nikolai and his crew (Miracle) were very helpful and had no problem helping us solve any issues we may have encountered.

name: Jon L.
text: Very communicative, extremely professional. Lots of variety. Would book again in a heartbeat!

name: Ricky P.
text: Phenomenal space and even better consideration and accommodation for the clients. Loved shooting here and will definitely be back. Thank you guys for everything! Our footage looks insane!!!

name: Kevin A.
text: Cole was awesome, the place was amazing. Cole was there to guide us every step of the way and even helped us get parking. He was very accommodating and friendly. Over all a great experience!

name: Monte M.
text: I had a great experience renting this production studio. The host was extremely cooperative, welcoming, and communicative throughout the entire process. The studio itself was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. All of the sets were beautiful, fully prepared, and ready to use when I arrived. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and I would definitely book this space again for future projects.

name: Zemmearija C.
text: Excellent experience. The host was professional, responsive, and incredibly accommodating throughout our shoot. He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. The space offered a variety of creative options, and the level of customer service made the experience stand out.

name: Leiloni D.
text: This space was 10/10 it had A/C and fans that made it a 1000/10. The host was very hands on and a quick responder very helpful and the space looks exactly like the pictures!! Such a fun vibrant space also had a speaker and cold water definitely can't wait to come back

name: Vee B.
text: Cole has bended over backwards to accommodate us and we appreciate it — amazing location for all content needs!

name: Grey W.
text: Crazy experience!! Amazing venue & even better service with very kind and patient hosts. Extremely professional environment that even provided a free space to park! Definitely coming back to make more content!!

name: Oliver S.
text: Nikolai was really helpful. Made the shoot very smooth to set up and let us up early to settle in. Would definitely book again!

name: Jeff F.
text: What a great studio! Great sets for a variety of moods / needs. Nikolai was a pleasure to deal with and super helpful. Would def book again!

name: Maxime J.
text: Amazing studio. There are many different props and scenes and the lighting is great. Hosts are super friendly and great communication. Appreciate y'all!

name: Maryna R.
text: studio with very diverse rooms, so be sure to take extra time, because you will definitely want to shoot more material! The host and administrator of the studio were very friendly and assisted a lot. Thank you!

name: Sarah W.
text: Great spot! Good vibes & lots of fun sets. I'll definitely be back & would recommend to anyone looking for a cool creative space to shoot photos. Thanks Nikolai!
